arxiv-2203-14399.title: Nonextensive Itô-Langevin Dynamics
arxiv-2203-14399.creator: Leonardo Santos
arxiv-2203-14399.description: Abstract We study generalizations of Itô-Langevin dynamics consistent within nonextensive thermostatistics. The corresponding stochastic differential equations are shown to be connected with a wide class of nonlinear Fokker-Planck equations describing correlated anomalous diffusion in fractals. A generalized central limit theorem is proposed in order to demonstrate how such equations emerge as a limit of correlated random variables.

arxiv-2209-07032.title: YITP-22-98 Real tensor eigenvalue/vector distributions of the Gaussian tensor model via a four-fermi theory
arxiv-2209-07032.creator: Naoki Sasakura
arxiv-2209-07032.description: Abstract Eigenvalue distributions are important dynamical quantities in matrix models, and it is an interesting challenge to study corresponding quantities in tensor models. We study real tensor eigenvalue/vector distributions for real symmetric order-three random tensors with the Gaussian distribution as the simplest case.

arxiv-2401-10841.title: Using LLMs to discover emerging coded antisemitic hate-speech in extremist social media Thanks: Research supported by American University’s Signature Research Initiative program. We thank Jacob Levine for his inspiration in the initial steps of this project.
arxiv-2401-10841.creator: Dhanush Kikkisetti, Raza Ul Mustafa, Wendy Melillo, Roberto Corizzo, Zois Boukouvalas, Jeff Gill, Nathalie Japkowicz
arxiv-2401-10841.description: Abstract Online hate speech proliferation has created a difficult problem for social media platforms. A particular challenge relates to the use of coded language by groups interested in both creating a sense of belonging for its users and evading detection. Coded language evolves quickly and its use varies over time.

arxiv-2405-20617.title: Large-scale Outdoor Cell-free mMIMO Channel Measurement in an Urban Scenario at 3.5 GHz Thanks: YZ and AFM are with the University of Southern California, Los Angeles, CA, USA; their work was financially supported by KDDI Research, Inc.. arxiv-2405-20617.description: Abstract The design of cell-free massive MIMO systems requires accurate, measurement-based channel models. This paper provides the first results from the by far most extensive outdoor measurement campaign for cell-free massive MIMO channels in an urban environment. We measured impulse responses between over 20,000 20,000 potential access point locations and 80 80 user equipments at 3.5 3.

arxiv-2504-01238.description: Abstract Boron monolayers, also known as borophene, have recently attracted interest due to their electronic properties, e.g. the facility to form various allotropes with interesting properties. arxiv-2506-14414.title: GHAR: GeoPose-based Handheld Augmented Reality for Architectural Positioning, Manipulation and Visual Exploration PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2021 IEEE
arxiv-2506-14414.creator: Sabahat Israr, Dawar Khan, Zhanglin Cheng, Mukhtaj Khan, Kiyoshi Kiyokawa
arxiv-2506-14414.description: Abstract Handheld Augmented Reality (HAR) is revolutionizing the civil infrastructure application domain. The current trend in HAR relies on marker tracking technology. However, marker-based systems have several limitations, such as difficulty in use and installation, sensitivity to light, and marker design. In this paper, we propose a markerless HAR framework with GeoPose-based tracking.

pmc-11644666.creator: Ivan Malashin, Dmitriy Martysyuk, Vadim Tynchenko, Andrei Gantimurov, Andrey Semikolenov, Vladimir Nelyub, Aleksei Borodulin, Raffaella Striani

pmc-12521405.title: Catalyst-controlled stereodivergent synthesis of polysubstituted alkenes
pmc-12521405.creator: Chengmi Huang, Dong Wu, Yu-Qing Zheng, Lujin Wang, Yuqiang Li, Yangyang Li, Wen-Bo Liu, Guoyin Yin
pmc-12521405.description: The strategic utilization of earth-abundant transition metals in catalysis has emerged as a trans-formative movement in advancing of synthetic chemistry. Despite notable progress, the potential of leveraging diverse geometric configurations of these catalysts to achieve divergent synthesis remains largely untapped. In this work, we present a stereodivergent three-component borylfunctionalization of alkynes, enabled by ligand-modulated geometric variations in nickel catalysts.
